documentation.content: The completion-sync job of __SERVICE__ (__STAGE__) failed three runs in about 15 minutes (it runs every 5). The workers' own screens stay right (they compute on read), but the stored completion flags the admin screens and the share page read stop following reviews, expiries and catalogue changes. Look at the log lines with alert="completion-sync-failed" (the error and the counts) and at `SELECT * FROM scheduled_jobs WHERE name = 'completion-sync'` (lastResult). The job resumes by itself once the cause is fixed. Design: aidlc-docs/construction/completion-api/nfr-design (record branch aidlc/onboarding-tour).
